desc: Implement modular arithmetic helpers (add, mul, pow) and precompute binomial coefficients $\binom{K}{j}$ modulo 998244353.
Read input $N, K$ and array $A$, then compute prefix sums $S_0, S_1, \dots, S_N$ modulo 998244353.
Initialize a total answer variable to 0 and an array `sum_powers` of size $K+1$ to store $\sum_{l < r} S_l^p$ for each power $p$.

Iterate $r$ from $1$ to $N$: for each $j$ from $0$ to $K$, add $\binom{K}{j} \cdot S_r^j \cdot (-1)^{K-j} \cdot \text{sum\_powers}[K-j]$ to the answer, then update `sum_powers[p]` by adding $S_r^p$ for all $p \in [0, K]$.
